bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 51.4K on Instagram, four products on Whop, and a 5-figure mentorship on top.
beats.text: Signals, a 3-day mentorship, Pip Precision Trading Academy and the Inner Circle all compete for the same follower. The one that matters most, the Inner Circle, is the hardest one to find.

beats.title: Your Linktree never sends anyone to the Inner Circle.
beats.text: The top link goes to Whop signals, then YouTube, your broker, your book and the free Telegram. The application page on donyellgreen.com isn't on it. Your free Telegram alone has 1,653 members who already follow your trades.

beats.title: The headline sells payouts. The program sells structure.
beats.text: The page promises $10K to $50K+ payouts, then lists one-day wins, then a disclaimer that nobody should expect similar results. Income headlines are the first thing Meta ad review and the FTC look at, and they attract buyers looking for a number, not a 120-day process.
beats.quote: “Struggling Traders Are Turning Small Accounts Into $10K, $20K, and $50K+ Payouts Using One Proven System”

beats.title: “I already have a funnel.” This keeps what works and fixes the handoff.
beats.text: The application, the booking page and your FAQ are good, and they carry over. What changes is the lead (the 120-day structure instead of payouts), six pre-call emails so booked applicants show up, and ads with no income claims.
beats.quote: “Your Call Is Not Yet Confirmed. Watch This Now.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You keep blowing accounts
cards.body: One oversized position or one revenge trade and the account is gone. The setup was fine. The risk wasn't.

cards.title: You're chasing indicators
cards.body: A new indicator, a new signal group, a new strategy. None of it sticks because there's no structure behind it.

cards.title: Demo feels fine, live doesn't
cards.body: Everything works until real money is on the line. Then the rules go out the window.

mechanism.title: The Flip Capital Framework
mechanism.body: Structure and discipline beat any indicator. Over 120 days you work through psychology, market structure, risk management and capital scaling, with live trade reviews along the way, from demo to live.

preCallEmails.previewText: Your call with the Flip Capital Academy team is confirmed
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

1. Keep the time free. The call takes 45 to 60 minutes.
2. Bring your broker history or a few screenshots if you have them. If you're brand new, just come ready to be honest about where you are.

preCallEmails.subject: Why most traders blow accounts
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most blown accounts don't come from a bad setup. They come from one oversized position, one revenge trade, or no stop when the day goes wrong.

That's why the Inner Circle starts with structure and risk, not a new indicator.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Team Flip Capital Academy

preCallEmails.subject: "I already follow the signals. Why more?"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Signals tell you what to trade today. They don't teach you why, and they don't fix the habits that blow accounts.

The Inner Circle is 120 days of structure: a roadmap, bi-weekly 1-on-1 calls with Donyell, weekly live sessions and direct chat.

If you don't need that, we'll tell you so on the call.

Team Flip Capital Academy

preCallEmails.subject: What the call is (and isn't)
preCallEmails.previewText: No signals, no promises, just a straight conversation
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

So you know what to expect:

- The call takes 45 to 60 minutes.
- We'll ask about your experience, your goals and what's been holding you back.
- If the Inner Circle fits, we'll explain what's included and the investment.
- If it doesn't, we'll tell you and point you to the free resources.

What the call isn't: no signals, no trade calls, no promises of profits. Trading involves substantial risk of loss.

Team Flip Capital Academy
